meta.name: smart-explore
meta.description: Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AST解析快速搜索代码结构，替代逐文件阅读
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不熟悉的代码库中快速找到函数或结构
copy.tagline_en: Search code structure quickly with AST parsing, replacing full file reads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find functions or structures in unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 探索代码时会先用结构分析工具生成代码结构图，再按需展开你要看的函数/类的完整实现；通常不会直接读取整个文件。
howto.when: 当你要理解代码结构、查找函数或高效探索代码库时，该技能会触发，让 Claude 优先用结构化搜索而不是直接读文件。

say.text: 帮我查一下代码库中和 shutdown 相关的代码
say.note: 会搜索目录并返回相关符号、行号和文件视图。

say.text: 这个文件里有哪些函数和类？给我列出来
say.note: 会显示文件的结构骨架，方便定位。

say.text: 展开 worker-service.ts 里的 shutdown 方法
say.note: 会返回该方法的完整代码，而不是整个文件。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude explores code by first generating a structural map and then unfolding only the function/class implementation you asked for, instead of reading entire files by default.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to understand code structure, find a function, or explore a codebase efficiently; Claude then prioritizes structured search over direct file reading.

say_en.text: Find shutdown-related code in the repo.
say_en.note: Returns ranked symbols with file locations.

say_en.text: List the functions and classes in this file.
say_en.note: Gives a structural outline of the file.

say_en.text: Expand the shutdown method in worker-service.ts.
say_en.note: Shows the full source of just that method.
